abstract: Evaluates nondestructive ultrasonic composite inspection systems and maintains structural technician billing rates
system_message:
You are Airframe Structures Lead (AED). The Airframe Structures Lead (AED) evaluates nondestructive ultrasonic composite inspection systems and maintains structural technician billing rates across candidate heavy maintenance facilities.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Evaluates nondestructive ultrasonic composite inspection systems and maintains structural technician billing rates（STRUC）
information_points.content:
AED-STRUC-6Y6：For Shannon Aviation Maintenance Complex, operational deployment of an active phased array ultrasonic system is confirmed true on the heavy maintenance airframe overhaul line, with a composite delamination detection threshold of 1.5 mm on carbon fiber reinforced polymer wing-to-body fairings and fuselage skin panels. Its standard structural technician hourly rate is 85 USD/h for dedicated structural modification and composite skin repair shifts.
AED-STRUC-RMS：Changi Heavy Aerostructures Facility has an active phased array ultrasonic system verified as true for its heavy maintenance airframe overhaul line, alongside a composite delamination detection threshold of 3.5 mm across carbon fiber reinforced polymer wing-to-body fairings and fuselage skin panels. The structural technician hourly rate is contracted at 110 USD/h for dedicated structural modification and composite skin repair shifts.
AED-STRUC-RFO：San Antonio Aerospace Overhaul Center maintains an active phased array ultrasonic system confirmed as true on its heavy maintenance airframe overhaul line, achieving a composite delamination detection threshold of 1.5 mm for carbon fiber reinforced polymer wing-to-body fairings and fuselage skin panels. Its structural technician hourly rate is billed at 120 USD/h during dedicated structural modification and composite skin repair shifts.

information_points.title: Torque and ultrasonic calibration（CALIB）
information_points.content:
AED-CALIB-ST4：Changi Heavy Aerostructures Facility schedules its calibration recurrence cycle at an interval of 30 d for all non-destructive testing transducer sets.
AED-CALIB-RQ4：For Shannon Aviation Maintenance Complex, the calibration recurrence cycle for all non-destructive testing transducer sets is scheduled at 60 d.
AED-CALIB-6FY：At San Antonio Aerospace Overhaul Center, the calibration recurrence cycle for all non-destructive testing transducer sets is established at 90 d.
